ORDER: First, the Court clarifies that the deadline for the parties' joint letter is TODAY at 5 p.m., not September 25, 2026; the Court apologizes for any confusion. Second, Respondents may preview their response to Petitioner's 11 Motion for Release Pending Adjudication of Petition Pursuant to Mapp v. Reno in the joint letter and should be prepared to discuss a briefing schedule for the motion, if not the motion itself, in the conference tomorrow. Unless and until the Court orders otherwise, Respondents shall file any opposition to the motion no later than Friday, October 2, 2026, and no reply may be filed without prior leave of Court. (HEREBY ORDERED by Judge Jesse M. Furman)(Text Only Order) (Furman, Jesse) (Entered: 09/28/2026)

ORDER: In light of the fact that Petitioner is now represented by counsel, see ECF No. 8, the briefing schedule set forth in the Court's Orders of September 22 and 24, 2026, see ECF Nos. 3 and 7, is vacated, and the conference previously schedu led for October 8, 2026, is CANCELED. Instead, counsel for all parties shall appear for a conference with the Court on September 29, 2026, at 4:15 p.m. The conference will be held remotely by telephone in accordance with Rule 3(B) of the Court's Individual Rules and Practices in Civil Cases, available at https://nysd.uscourts.gov/hon-jesse-m-furman. The parties should join the conference by calling the Court's dedicated conference line at (855) 244-8681 and using access code 2303 019 3 884, followed by the pound (#) key. When prompted for an attendee ID number, press the pound (#) key again and further set forth in this Order. ( Telephone Conference set for 9/29/2026 at 04:15 PM before Judge Jesse M. Furman.) Case Designated ECF. (kgo)

CASE MANAGEMENT NOTE: For each electronic filing made in a case involving a self-represented party who has not consented to electronic service, the filing party must serve the document on such self-represented party in a manner permitted by Fed. R. Civ. P. 5(b)(2) (other than through the ECF system) and file proof of service for each document so served. Please see Rule 9.2 of the courts ECF Rules & Instructions for further information..(kgo)

Magistrate Judge Robyn F. Tarnofsky is designated to handle matters that may be referred in this case. Pursuant to 28 U.S.C. Section 636(c), Fed. R. Civ. P. 73(b)(1), and Local Civil Rule 73.1, parties are notified that they may, with the approval of the assigned District Judge, consent to proceed before a United States Magistrate Judge. Parties who wish to consent may access the necessary form at the following link: https://nysd.uscourts.gov/sites/default/files/2018-06/AO-3.pdf. (kgo)

STAY OF REMOVAL AND NOTICE OF CONFERENCE (IMMIGRATION CASES): Petitioner has, through next friend Mariama Bah, filed a Petition for the writ of habeas corpus under 28 U.S.C. § 2241. The Court, having examined the Petition, hereby ORDERS that: (1) Within two business days of the date of this Order, Respondents shall file a letter with the following information: a. whether Petitioner was, as the Petition alleges, see ECF No. 1, PP 1, 15, located in the Southern District of New York at the time that the Petition was filed and, if not, what District Petitioner was in at the time of filing and whether the Petition should be immediately transferred to that District, see, e.g., ztürk v. Hyde, 136 F.4th 382, 391-92 (2d Cir. 2025); Khalil v. Joyce, 771 F. Supp. 3d 268 (S.D.N.Y. 2025); As further set forth in this Order, The parties shall then appear for an in-person conference with the Court on October 8, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. in Courtroom 24B of the Daniel Patrick Moynihan Courthouse, 500 Pearl Street, New York, NY. Respondents shall produce Petitioner at the conference. As further set forth herein The Court directs the Clerk of Court to mail a copy of this order to Petitioner at the address listed on the docket sheet for this action and transmit a copy of this order to her next friend by email to bahm610@gmail.com. Bah may receive court documents by email by completing the form, which is attached to this Order Consent to Electronic Service. SO ORDERED. (Signed by Judge Jesse M. Furman o

ORDER DIRECTING PAYMENT OF FEE OR IFP APPLICATION: Accordingly, within 30 days of the date of this order, Petitioner or Bah must pay the $5.00 filing fee or submit a completed and signed IFP application, the form for which is attached to this Order. If an IFP application is filed, it should be labeled with docket number 26-CV-8227 (JMF). If the Court grants the IFP application, this action will proceed without the prepayment of fees. See 28 U.S.C. § 1915(a)(1). If Petitioner or next friend fails to comply with this Order within the time allowed, and does not request additional time to respond, the Court will dismiss this action without further notice. The Court directs the Clerk of Court to mail a copy of this order to Petitioner at the address listed on the docket sheet for this action and transmit a copy of this order to her next friend by email to bahm610@gmail.com. Bah may receive court documents by email by completing the form, Consent to Electronic Service. SO ORDERED. (Signed by Judge Jesse M. Furman on 9/22/2026) Filing Fee due by 10/22/2026.
